description: Evaluation cases for compact horizontal KPI tile composition, data integrity, and semantic trend interpretation.

evals.prompt: Create a compact KPI tile: latency is 18 ms, down 12% versus the previous 7 days, lower is better. A real ordered 7-day series is supplied.
expected: sparkline appears only from supplied series
better is supported by lower-is-better semantics

evals.prompt: Create a compact tile for open backlog 236, down 14 versus previous week. No time series is available.
expected: shows current value, label and delta

evals.prompt: CPU utilization changed from 80% to 72%. Create a tile; no target or preferred range is defined.
expected: does not label decrease better or worse
does not use semantic green/red status

evals.prompt: A metric changed from 0 to 12. Show percentage change in a compact tile.
expected: relative percentage change is stated as undefined
does not show infinity or fabricated percentage

evals.prompt: Conversion rate changed from 12% to 15%. Create a compact tile.
expected: does not confuse pp with relative percent
names comparison period only if supplied
prefers unambiguous wording such as vs previous 7 days
does not invent a date range or calendar interpretation

evals.prompt: Delta compares previous 7 days, but the supplied sparkline covers the previous 30 days.
expected: does not imply both representations cover the same period
labels the series period separately or omits sparkline

evals.prompt: Create a tile with current value 236 and no previous value, target, or time series.
expected: omits delta, arrow, sparkline and status
does not represent missing data as zero

evals.prompt: Current availability is 96%, target is 99.9%, but no status thresholds are defined.
expected: may show target and numeric gap

evals.prompt: Generate self-contained HTML for eight compact KPI tiles.
